articles.summary: There are side activities to suit every hobby in Grand Theft Auto VI, whether you prefer to sit back and play a video game, indulge in a little sport, or
articles.body:
There are side activities to suit every hobby in Grand Theft Auto VI , whether you prefer to sit back and play a video game, indulge in a little sport, or you’d rather put the pedal to the metal, there are plenty of ways to spend your downtime in Leonida. In this official IGN GTA 6 guide, you'll find an overview of all the different side activities you can participate in, with links to individual guides where you’ll find details on each activity, challenge, and special rewards you can unlock for completing them.

For those who like their sport, there’s a wide variety of activities you can take part in, from fishing and hunting to mini golf and shooting hoops.

Go for gold and net yourself a tidy profit in the meantime. There are 39 races to complete, rent a car, and leave challengers in the dust.

You’ll find a few race clubs and raceways across Leonida, each with their own unique racing challenges. Spend time at the Thrillbilly Mud Club or visit the Gelhorn Raceway and see if you have what it takes to come first in time trials, stunt runs, and more.

Think you’re a quick shot? Test your marksman skills across 12 different shooting ranges, with themes that include Zombies, Cops & Robbers, and Aliens. Use a variety of pistols and see how well you rank.

If you were hoping to play a game within a game, you’re in luck. Not only will you be able to boot up a selection of games on your console at home, you can also visit arcade cabinets in a number of locations and play Bang For Your Buck.

The Leonida landscape makes for a giant assault course, where you can complete a variety of stunts. So throw on a parachute or use a tiny plane and complete these daredevil challenges.

If you’d rather race something other than a car, Top Fun Drones gives you the chance to be a pilot and take on challenging courses. Across the 42 races, you’ll have par times that you’ll want to beat to earn cash rewards.

articles.summary: The Fishing Shacks Robbery Opportunity is an early Illegal Operation that Jason can do to earn some extra money in Grand Theft Auto VI. This official IGN GTA 6
articles.body:
The Fishing Shacks Robbery Opportunity is an early Illegal Operation that Jason can do to earn some extra money in Grand Theft Auto VI . This official IGN GTA 6 guide walks you through the Fishing Shacks Kingfishers Robbery Opportunity, including how to start it, best strategy, and Key Valuable locations.

Click on a link below to jump to that specific section of this guide:

GTA 6 Fishing Shacks Robbery Opportunity Walkthrough

To the north of Key Lento, you’ll spot Cottonmouth Lake, and to the west of that is Weman Bay, which is where the Fishing Shacks - Kingfishers Illegal Operation takes place. If you do not see the icon for it on your map, approaching it will make it appear.

Because the Robbery Opportunity is on an island, you’ll need a boat or jet ski to get there. Before you start traveling by water, you’ll want to also make sure you stop at an Ammu-Nation or your private vehicle and bring a powerful Longarm with you, so that way you’re prepared for a shootout.

When approaching the island, it’s recommended that you come from the southwest. So long as you don’t enter the yellow radius, you shouldn’t be spotted.

After leaving your boat and landing on the island, you’ll hear sporadic gunshots coming from the southern area of the operation. Going into Focus Mode ( Left Stick Click + Right Stick Click / Left Stick Click + Right Stick Click ) will show the ripples, letting you know where the sound is coming from.

Crouch and approach slowly to spot two Kingfishers shooting into the ocean. Don’t approach them and instead watch as a wild alligator attempts to eat them. They’ll win the fight, but it’s a good time to sneak around them or take them out yourself. Just be sure to watch out for alligators yourself as they’ll be lined along the coastline. Enter Focus Mode to spot them easily, as they’ll flash white.

When approaching from the south, after taking out the alligator folks, you’ll head north into the operation compound and be met with some resistance – about 4-5 enemies. There is a lot of cover in this bar section, as well as a big explosive behind the bar. Use Focus Mode to see the outlines of enemies, as well as the red object outlines showing you where some throwables and a big explosive are.

Take the enemies out here but be aware that there are more enemies to the west, inside the house on the dock. Before leaving this area, make your way around the bar to spot a crate of Molotov cocktails. Tap L1 / LB to fully stock up on these just in case you want to use them in combat.

While the house on the docks may have a huge window for Jason to peer through, you’ll likely find that the enemies aren’t inside but instead staged behind the house.

Make your way through or around the house, using cover as needed to dispatch these final enemies. Remember to toggle in and out of Focus Mode to see the red outlines of enemies, even when they’re behind cover.

The final danger you’ll need to be aware of is alligators. Even when in the compound, alligators can still be around and attack enemies. This is helpful, but alligators don’t just have a taste for Kingfisher blood - they’ll attack Jason as well. Enter Focus Mode to see if an alligator is red, and if so, that means it’s aggressive and will need to be put down.

It’s good practice to loot any downed enemy during (if it’s safe) and after combat. Looting enemies will earn you some cash, which is great during these early missions, but almost more importantly is their ammo, guns, and Zombix .

After dispatching an enemy, press Triangle / Y to loot it, which will either give you ammo, cash, or Zombix. Furthermore, enemies will drop their hats, sunglasses, and weapons on the ground when taken out as well. These can dynamically be seen and looted off the ground by pressing L1 / LB .

Just be aware that while you’ll want to take your time looting, the longer you stay, random Kingfishers will keep sporadically showing up, and you’ll need to take them out. Same for the police; linger too long and the police scanner will warn you the law is on their way.

While not Key Valuables, these compounds often feature drugs, jewelry, marked bills, and other illegal items for Jason and Lucia to collect and sell. In this Robbery Opportunity, make sure to look inside the small red shack opposite of the bar (not the house on the dock). Inside you’ll find some ammo, but more importantly, some cocaine bricks. Make sure to grab those to sell to Brian for a few hundred bucks each.

Inside the big house on the dock is where you’ll find even more cocaine and some loose cash. Enter the house, either through the door or the giant window, and use Focus Mode to look at the table. Anything purple is a cocaine brick, and the green rolls are cash.

At this point, you should have around $1,920 in cocaine. You can check this by opening your weapon wheel, scrolling to items, and pressing down on the right stick to hover over the stash bag; the bottom-right of the screen will list how much you have collected so far.

There is only one Key Valuable in the Fishing Shacks Illegal Opportunity, and it’s inside the big house. When looking at the kitchen sink, you’ll see a rifle in a gun case on the left kitchen counter, across from the wooden chair.

If you’re having trouble spotting it, open your map to see its location, indicated by a gold gun icon. Inside the case is a Kingfishers W-22 Small Game Rifle, which comes equipped with a silencer. Once you pick up the gun, the map will update, informing you that you’ve found all the Key Valuables in this location.

Once you’ve looted everything, you can either find the boat you came with on your map and radar and use that to make your escape, or head to the dock right outside the house to the north. Here, you’ll find a Lure Predator boat, a Bombora boat, or the Mammoth Dodo sea plane. Use any of these to escape the area.

To sell your drugs, make sure to return them to a drug fence – if you’re in Chapter 1, this will be either Brian or Donnie.

articles.summary: Exotic Animals Front is one of the first Illegal Operations you’ll encounter in Grand Theft Auto VI (not counting the Kingfisher’s Breeding Camp,
articles.body:
Exotic Animals Front is one of the first Illegal Operations you’ll encounter in Grand Theft Auto VI (not counting the Kingfisher’s Breeding Camp, which is the Prologue mission). It involves a liquor store, some thugs, and a talking bird - classic stuff. This official IGN GTA 6 guide walks you through the Exotic Animals Front Strange Noises Illegal Operation, including how to start it and the Key Valuable location.

Exotic Animals Front Illegal Operation Walkthrough

The Exotic Animals Front Illegal Operation will unlock after you’ve entered the Three Sheets liquor store in Key Lento and asked the clerk about the bird noises coming from the back. This occurs naturally during the mission where Shirley asks you to retrieve her rum from the liquor store (make sure to complete Shirley's mission first so the store doesn’t lock you out after completing the Illegal Operation!).

Three Sheets is located just east of Donnie's trailer in Key Lento.

When looking at the Three Sheets Liquor store, go around the left to spot a chain link fence. Run up to it and jump over; don’t worry about the height - Jason can climb chain-link fences.

After getting over the fence, look to the right wall and spot a small chain-link door, right next to the “No Trespassing” graffiti. Before going through, make sure you’re ready for a shoot out as the men will attack you on sight.

Once you've passed through the gate, there will be three enemies: one in front of you that you can choke out if you’d like, one at the table to your left, and one coming out of the door to your right. As the fight starts, another man will come from the left side as well. They do have guns, but you do, too. Pull out your pistol and shoot the men until you’ve taken them all out.

The enemy to your right might be very close; in this case, just melee him which will pistol whip him, taking him out quickly.

After the men are down, go ahead and quickly loot their bodies and grab their guns if you’d like – any extra money this early in the story is always a good thing. Just be aware that the police will likely already be alerted to your location, so you’ll need to move quickly.

Once you’ve looted everyone, you’ll want to talk to the parrot who keeps talking about cash. The parrot is located in the center of the back area. When facing the back of the store, the cage is to the right of a pallet of sacks. Interact with the parrot and ask it about the cash location.

After talking to the bird a few times, it will mention a generator. Immediately left of the parrot cage is a black and yellow generator on the ground tucked into the corner.

Approach the generator to spot a small vent near the ground. Interact with the vent to collect your reward: $1,366 .

At this point, the cops are well on their way, so once you have the cash, make sure to flee the scene before you catch any heat. If the police do spot you, head to our Wanted Level guide to learn how to best flee from the law.

For more GTA 6 Illegal Operations guides , check out:

articles.summary: Brooks Boatworks is an Illegal Operation ran by the Kolt & Associates gang in Grand Theft Auto VI. It’s home to four Key Valuables, including a
articles.body:
Brooks Boatworks is an Illegal Operation ran by the Kolt & Associates gang in Grand Theft Auto VI . It’s home to four Key Valuables, including a unique weapon variant and a standout vehicle. This official IGN GTA 6 guide teaches you how to find all Key Valuable locations – including the safe code – and points out additional, optional items to help you make more money.

Click on a link below to jump to that section of this guide:

Kolt & Associates Brooks Boatworks Location

The Kolt & Associates Brooks Boatworks Illegal Operation is located north of the Pay ‘n’ Spray in Port Gellhorn, Kelly County , and becomes available in Chapter 2.

You can enter however you’d like, though note that the two main entrances to the left and right of the compound are locked initially and you can’t climb over.

I accessed the boatworks by going through a gap in the fence in the middle of the two entrances. Look for some upturned boats and you’ll see the break in the fence ahead of you. Go through and you’ll also find a KZ-59 Assault Rifle that can be very useful when dealing with the enemies inside.

The docks are heavily guarded by Kolt & Associates gang members. You can take the stealthy approach, of course, but you’ll need to be extra careful to avoid being spotted due to how many there are.

Like many other Illegal Operations, a shotgun is a solid weapon to bring in with you due to how quickly you can dispatch anyone who comes too close to you.

Brooks Boatworks has four Key Valuables to find. Click on one below to learn more information:

The first Key Valuable is a safe, and it’s located inside the main warehouse building in the top of the area.

As you enter the warehouse, you’ll hear some thugs shouting about getting the boat out of there. If you can stop them from driving the boat away (it’s directly in front of you as you enter), you’ll find a black trunk on its deck that you can open with Triangle / X . Inside, there’s three bags of pills you can sell at a fence, a SMG if you need a better weapon, and $198 cash.

Go up the stairs inside the warehouse and enter the long room. The safe is in here, though if you don’t have Sticky Bombs unlocked, you’ll need to find the safe code to open it.

The safe code is located in the building to the right of the main warehouse , on the east side of the compound.

Head inside and look on the wall above the weapon case (this is the second Key Valuable; grab it now if you want) and you’ll spot a map you can inspect. Do so with L2 / LT and you’ll see three codes – the game will automatically add Tap to Reveal to your notes, which is the safe code.

Looking at the map will also reveal two more safe codes: one for another nearby Robbery Opportunity at the La Cascara Motel to the southwest and another for a safe at the Kingpin Bowling alley.

Open the safe, either by force or with the safe code, and you’ll find $1,500 cash on the top shelf and $665 on the middle shelf, totaling $2,165 .

Before you move on, there are some optional items to pick up in this room. Turn around from the safe and pick up the cash from the money counting machine on the table, totaling $418 .

Look on the pool table in front of the money counting machine; there’s two bags of pills here that you can sell to a fence and a pack of cigarettes .

If you need healing, there’s a Zombix on the table behind the pool table and a first aid cabinet on the wall in the back, which contains a second Zombix and an Adrenaline .

The second Key Valuable is another safe, and it’s located inside the wooden green building to the left of the main warehouse .

Go up the stairs on the outside and look for a white door next to a locked box on the wall, as shown in our screenshot below.

Head inside and walk all the way to the back, picking off any enemies that may be in here. The safe is inside a small office room, on top of a filing cabinet.

Unlike the other safe, you don’t need a code to open it. Instead, press Triangle / X and then use Right Stick to jimmy it open using a screwdriver. There’s $1,409 cash inside.

Before leaving the building, there are some additional valuables here to grab. Look right of the safe to find $337 in cash.

Head into the kitchen on the same floor and check the table for $294 in cash. There’s also a first aid box on the wall if you need heals. It contains an Adrenaline .

The third Key Valuable is the Vapid Smuggler Caracara standout vehicle , located outside the wooden green building where Key Valuable 2 is. It’s parked right out front and is bright orange so it’s impossible to miss.

The truck is unlocked and has no security alarms, so it’s yours for the taking, hassle free! It has a sell value of $6,325 and costs $5,550 to register.

Note that you’ll need to get inside the truck for the Key Valuable to count as found.

The fourth and final Key Valuable is inside the building to the right of the main warehouse building . If you got the safe code earlier, it’s in the same room so you may have already grabbed it. But if not, follow on.

Go up the stairs and enter the building. Immediately, you’ll spot the Clunker 556 Assault Rifle unique weapon variant on the table in front of the whiteboard.

Look on the desk to the left of the weapon case to find $168 in cash.

With the last Key Valuable obtained, you’re done with the Brooks Boatworks Illegal Operation.

This walkthrough features some first-person elements. Those come from IGN's GTA 6 Editor, Meg Koepp. You can learn more about her and her experience on the About the Guide Editors page.

articles.title: Kingpin Bowling - GTA 6 Guide - IGN
articles.summary: Kingpin Bowling is an Illegal Operation run by the Kolt & Associates gang in Grand Theft Auto VI. It is home to three Key Valuables, including a luxury
articles.body:
Kingpin Bowling is an Illegal Operation run by the Kolt & Associates gang in Grand Theft Auto VI . It is home to three Key Valuables, including a luxury watch and a unique weapon variant. This official IGN GTA 6 guide teaches you how to find every Key Valuable location and points out additional, optional items you can grab along the way for a better take value.

NOTE : You can complete this Illegal Operation in the Hit Kingpin Bowling optional mission in Chapter 2. If you did that mission and didn't find all three Key Valuables, it'll appear as an Illegal Operation you can come back to later.

Click on a link below to jump to that section of this guide:

Kolt & Associates Kingpin Bowling Location

The Kingpin Bowling Illegal Operation is located just south of the Pawn & Gun Ammu-Nation store in Port Gellhorn, Kelly County . It first becomes available during the Coffee Break main mission , where four objectives will appear on your map; this one shows as the Hit Kingpin Bowling optional mission.

There is no “right” way to enter Kingpin Bowling, though there are two entrances to the location – one to the west and one on the east side. The one to the west leads to the building’s main entrance, but you can enter however you’d like.

There are three Key Valuables in the Kingpin Bowling Illegal Operation. Click on one below for more information on how to find it:

The first Key Valuable is a safe, located in an office in the back of the main Kingpin Bowling building .

While there are multiple ways to reach the safe, here’s how I found it if you need more help locating it.

Go to the back of Kingpin Bowling, which is on the far east side when looking at the map. You’ll reach a counter with a Staff Only door and a “CHILLED” fridge.

Just left of this counter, there’s a door that says “Storage” on it. Go inside.

On your left, there’s a wooden door with an “Office” sign. This is the room where the safe is.

There are two ways to open the safe: by using Sticky Bombs or by entering a safe code.

The code for the Kingpin Bowling safe is located at Brooks Boatworks , another Illegal Operation led by Kolt & Associates, which you’ll see a hint for if you read the notepad on the table in front of the safe.

The safe code is located in the building to the right of the Brooks Boathouse main warehouse , on the east side of the compound.

Head inside and look on the wall above the weapon case to spot a map you can inspect. Do so with L2 / LT and you’ll see three codes, including the one for the Kingpin Bowling safe ( Tap to Reveal ), and the Brooks Boathouse and La Cascara Motel safes, too.

Open the safe however you see fit, and you’ll find $2,582 on the top shelf and $1,258 on the middle shelf, totaling $3,840 .

The second Key Valuable is the Gutterball Moreland 850 Shotgun unique weapon variant and it’s located at the back of Kingpin Bowling (on the east side if you’re looking at the map) on top of a pool table. It’s just to the left of the office room where the safe is.

The third and final Key Valuable is the Crowex Octane ‘Orca’ luxury watch. It’s located on the right side of Kingpin Bowling, or south if you’re looking at the map.

It’s inside the room to the left of the bowling lanes, as shown in our screenshot below.

Go into the room and you’ll see it on a small table in the corner.

Check the table in the middle of the room with the watch to find a Zombix and $552 in cash.

With the third Key Valuable found, there are some additional pickups you can grab if you didn't during the Hit Kingpin Bowling optional mission.

Head to the middle of the main Kingpin Bowling building, behind the wooden dividers. If you haven’t taken them out already, there will be a handful of gang members guarding the area.

Look on the tables here to find several bags of pills that you can sell to a fence.

If you’re having trouble finding them all, use Focus Mode ( Left Stick Click + Right Stick Click / Left Stick Click + Right Stick Click ). The pill bags will highlight purple, making them much easier to spot.

For more GTA 6 Illegal Operations guides , check out:

This walkthrough features some first-person elements. Those come from IGN's GTA 6 Editor, Meg Koepp. You can learn more about her and her experience on the About the Guide Editors page.

articles.title: La Cascara Motel - GTA 6 Guide - IGN
articles.summary: La Cascara Motel is an Illegal Operation led by the Kolt & Associates gang in Grand Theft Auto VI. It has three Key Valuables to find, including a standout
articles.body:
La Cascara Motel is an Illegal Operation led by the Kolt & Associates gang in Grand Theft Auto VI . It has three Key Valuables to find, including a standout vehicle and a unique weapon variant. This official IGN GTA 6 guide teaches you how to find every Key Valuable location and highlights additional, optional items you can grab while you’re there.

Found a safe code on a map in a security office. OR A scrawled note with a safe code said something was delivered to this abandoned hotel.

Click on a link below to jump to that section of this guide:

Kolt & Associates La Cascara Motel Location

The Kolt & Associates La Cascara Motel Illegal Opportunity is located on the west side of Port Gellhorn in Kelly County, just northeast of Wild Hog Point . It appears on your map after you find the safe code during the Brooks Boatworks Illegal Operation or after reading a notepad in the June Warehouse Illegal Operation .

There’s no specific entrance to the motel, so feel free to approach from any side you like. There is heavy gang activity outside the front, so if you’re coming from that side, make sure you have healing items and a good weapon on you. A shotgun or assault rifle works well here.

The La Cascara Motel Illegal Opportunity has three Key Valuables to hunt down. Click on a link below for detailed instructions on finding each one:

The first Key Valuable is the Vapid Firebug Dominator standout vehicle, which is located in front of the motel, parked on the east side .

The car is bright red and very hard to miss, so you shouldn’t have trouble finding it. Just be careful as you approach as if you haven’t taken out the thugs outside the motel yet, they’ll turn hostile and attack.

When you go to get in the the car, you’ll notice it’s locked and you need to either break the window or use a Slim Jim to be able to hotwire and drive it.

The second Key Valuable is a safe, located in a room on the top floor of the motel.

There are multiple routes you can take up there, but I’ll detail mine below if you need some help finding it.

Note that I’ll be skipping optional pickups and explaining them later instead, but feel free to grab whatever you’d like as you pass it.

Go all the way to the right side of the motel and you’ll see an opening in the wooden paneling, to the left of an old, stained mattress. Go through and immediately go up the stairs to the right.

You’ll eventually reach a floor with green mesh coverings as walls. Go into the second door on the right.

Turn left and follow the path through the rooms until you see some graffiti that reads something like “SATIN RODIZ.” Go left here and through the door.

Continue on ahead, keeping tightly along the right wall to cross the gap, then go up the ramp ahead of you.

Go forward and then turn right into the second doorway.

Continue through to the back of the room, where you’ll reach a stone ramp you can climb up. Do so.

At the top, go out onto the balcony and turn left.

Follow the path all the way left and into a gated section of building.

Go through various rooms until you eventually reach a gated room; you can see a huge safe in there. That’s the Key Valuable.

You can either use Sticky Bombs to explode the safe door open or enter a safe code to get inside.

The code to the La Cascara Motel safe is not found inside the motel. Instead, it’s at the Brooks Boatworks to the northeast, which is another Illegal Operation led by the Kolt & Associates gang.

The safe code is located in the building to the right of the Brooks Boathouse main warehouse, on the east side of the compound.

Head inside and look on the wall above the weapon case and you’ll spot a map you can inspect. Do so with L2 / LT and you’ll see three codes, including the one for the Brook Boathouse safe, too. The game will automatically add Tap to Reveal to your notes, which is the Las Cascara Motel safe code.

Open the safe however you see fit and you’ll find $1,558 in cash on the top shelf and $681 on the middle shelf, totaling $2,239 .

The third and final Key Valuable is located on the top floor of the motel, just past the Key Valuable safe . Head right past the safe room and you’ll find the Scrapper VF5C SMG unique weapon variant in a weapon case in the back left.

You’ve found all three Key Valuables in the La Cascara Motel and can leave if you’d like, but there are some optional items to grab that can increase your payout.

Look on the wall to the left of the weapon case containing the Scrapper VF5C SMG to find some Body Armor you can wear for more protection. There’s also an explosives crate containing Sticky Bombs and Frag Grenades just to the right of it.

There’s a table directly opposite the weapon case with a money counting machine on it and some cash to grab: $338 , to be exact.

Go back to where the safe is and then continue through the series of rooms. Eventually, you’ll reach a room with four bags of pills on the table.

Continue through for another table with four more bags of pills . You can sell all drugs you find here to a fence.

Go down to the floor below and you’ll find a room with five bags of weed on one of the tables.

Follow the orange and blue cables on the floor through to another room, where you’ll reach another table with three more bags of weed to sell.

This walkthrough features some first-person elements. Those come from IGN's GTA 6 Editor, Meg Koepp. You can learn more about her and her experience on the About the Guide Editors page.

articles.title: About the GTA 6 Guide Editors - GTA 6 Guide - IGN
articles.summary: Every guide at IGN is produced in collaboration by multiple passionate writers and video editors who thoroughly research, test, and edit their work. The
articles.body:
Every guide at IGN is produced in collaboration by multiple passionate writers and video editors who thoroughly research, test, and edit their work. The Official GTA 6 Guide and is produced by the following staff experts:

Miranda Sanchez - Lead Editor and Writer

Miranda spearheaded the GTA 6 guide planning alongside her co-lead, Mark Medina, along with writing a majority of the walkthrough . She's also contributed to many features and other pages throughout the guide. Her go-to radio stations are Cocoteo FM and Flash FM.

Miranda was obsessed with GTA 5 when she played it on her trusty Xbox 360 in college, and spent over a 70 hours just hunting in Red Dead Redemption 2 (for guide research, and for fun) before getting to anything else. Other notable guides she's led include Cyberpunk 2077 , The Legend of Zelda: Echoes of Wisdom , and many more.

Meg is an Editor and writer on this official GTA 6 guide, focusing on walkthroughs, features, and Illegal Operations. She has been playing Grand Theft Auto games since GTA Vice City (yes, as a seven-year-old, shhh) and her favorite in the series before GTA 6 was IV.

When she’s not sneaking into gang camps across Leonida to find all the Key Valuables, Meg spends her time in GTA 6 finding ridiculous ways to harass innocent NPCs - did you know you can pelt beachgoers with a volleyball for the most melodramatic reactions? It’s so funny.

Other IGN projects Meg has worked on include Fortnite, Destiny 2, and Hollow Knight: Silksong. You can learn more about Meg on her author page .

Samuel Claiborn's earliest GTA projects included running Cheat Code pages for GTA 3, Vice City, and San Andreas sometime in the mid 2000s for IGN. He has since headed up every Rockstar game guide on IGN to follow, including Red Dead Redemption, GTA 5, and Red Dead Redemption 2, where he covered collectibles, walkthroughs, interactive maps, and yes, cheat codes. Always. Cheat codes.

Shailyn Cotten - Database Editor and Writer

As IGN's Guide Checklists Editor, the only thing Shailyn Cotten loves more than checking off her to-do list is Breath of the Wild... and possibly frogs. She’s built dozens of checklists and data tables for IGN Guides, and written guides for games such as Pokemon Pokopia, Hello Kitty Island Adventure, Madison , Dead Island 2, Avatar: Frontiers of Pandora , and more. Her biggest accomplishment aside from completing a 3-heart Breath of the Wild run is having the most contributions to IGN’s Tears of the Kingdom guide. Writing 200 Korok location guides really adds up.

Kerry started freelancing for IGN when he created a video showing all 50 of GTA 5’s Letter Scraps collectibles. 6 years later, and now, as a Guides Editor, Kerry has contributed to IGN's GTA 6 video walkthrough, as well as various features and how-tos, such as the official Beginner’s Guide and Tips , Sex and Romance, and Criminal Profile guide pages, just to name a few.

One of Kerry’s favorite ways to play GTA 6 is to drive to a beautiful location in a fast car, park it, turn on the radio, and watch as the cinematic camera captures Jason and/or Lucia jamming out to some tunes while watching the sun set.

Or if he's feeling more chaotic, trying to survive a high wanted-level for as long as possible!

Mitchell Saltzman - Writer and Video Editor

Mitchell Saltzman is a Senior Guides Producer who works on the video team. His first memory with the GTA series is playing GTA 3 on his best friend's PC, taking turns to see who could survive the longest with a five star wanted level while also causing the most chaos.

To that end, a lot of his focus with this guide was learning the ins and outs of causing chaos in GTA 6, including learning how to steal a tank and the inner workings governing the Wanted and Heat systems. Strangely enough though, his favorite moments of GTA 6 are the ones in between the chaos. The tender relationship building bits between Jason and Lucia, the wild and emergent interactions that can be had with NPCs, and even just people watching on the beaches of Leonida.

Casey DeFreitas is a Deputy Editor on IGN’s guides team and has written guides for IGN for ten years and counting. She’s contributed extensively to guides for a huge variety of games like Red Dead Redemption 2 , Pokemon Scarlet and Violet , The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom , and Monster Hunter Wilds . As a native Floridian who still calls the Sunshine State her home, Casey’s most looking forward to interacting with Leonida’s wildlife, but her GTA 6 guide efforts are focused on finding cool weapon variants, testing infiltration strategies for Illegal Operations, and likely a whole lot more.

Rory is IGN's QA-focused Guides Editor. Like many, his first Grand Theft Auto game was GTA 5, which he played at launch when he was way too young for it. Once GTA Online was released, he inevitably spent many late nights doing absurd bike parkour and races with friends. Since then, Rockstar’s Red Dead Redemption 2 almost instantly became his favourite game of all time, solidifying his hype for GTA 6, where he's spent most of his time hunting down Leonida's many collectibles.

Angie is IGN's Weekend Guides Editor and has long been an avid fan of the Grand Theft Auto games, having played every entry in the series and even purchasing a PSP for the timed exclusives. Some of her fondest gaming memories include spending her summers cruising Vice City Beach or the rural country roads of Red County in GTA: San Andreas. Angie is most excited to track down the many secrets and easter eggs hidden within Leonida, as well as spend countless hours customizing vehicles.

No AI is used in creating any of IGN's written or video guides. IGN's guides are, always, made by human writers and video editors with relevant experience to create the best guides possible. Every project member is required to play the game they cover in order to verify information accurately — which isn't a hard ask, as all individuals IGN's guide team works with enjoy video games and want to help others enjoy them too. articles.title: Find the Lost Drugs Walkthrough - GTA 6 Guide - IGN
articles.summary: Find the Lost Drugs is an Optional Mission offered by Cal during Grand Theft Auto VI’s Chapter 1. There are four drug spots to find and if you head
articles.body:
Find the Lost Drugs is an Optional Mission offered by Cal during Grand Theft Auto VI ’s Chapter 1. There are four drug spots to find and if you head there, you’ll score some cocaine packages to sell for some easy cash. This official IGN GTA 6 guide walks you through all four Find the Lost Drugs locations, including map screenshots so you can hunt them down quickly.

Click on a link below to jump to that section of this guide:

GTA 6 Find the Lost Drugs Walkthrough and Guide

We recommend completing the Find the Lost Drugs mission before the Clear Skies main mission to score the most money. If you do the main mission afterward, you'll only have one place to sell the drugs, which offers less cash.

Once the Find the Lost Drugs mission unlocks in GTAVI Chapter 1 , you’ll get four locations to visit to score cocaine bricks, all of which are marked on your map, just north of Key Lento.

To get these easily, drive to the first location while keeping an eye out for an off-road vehicle, as this is rough terrain that Jason's car will not handle very well.

If you have the Ultimate Edition, check under Jason's safehouse, as there’s usually a Dinka Enduro motorbike parked underneath that would be well suited for this trip.

Don't worry about needing your personal trunk; Jason can hold all the cocaine you will gather from all four missions.

You should bring a gun , though, as each location will have some resistance.

Starting in Key Lento, navigate to the southernmost lost drugs area: the Recreation Area, as shown in our map screenshot below:

This one is on the beach line, and when approaching from east side of the beach, you will see a truck, within some men in front of it gathered around a tree. Take these men out and listen for the beeping – that’s the drug package signal. The Recreation Area has two drug packages.

The first package is up in the tree that the men were gathered around. You’ll see it blinking red in the tree in front of the truck when looking north. You will need to shoot the package down with a gun to grab it or drive the nearby truck forward and climb onto its hood to reach it.

The second package is on the dock when facing south toward the beach. When looking at the dock, you will see a boat on the very right, and just to the left of the boat is the blinking red light on the package. Make your way across the shallow water to grab it.

The Burned Houses area is located just northwest of the Recreation Area, southwest of Cottonmouth Lake, as shown in our map screenshot below:

It is entirely possible to avoid combat when at the Burned Houses, as some men may approach from the west in a wind boat. They might spot you, but the packages are just far enough for you to get them if you are quick about it. Also, this drop has three packages to find.

If you GPS yourself from the Recreation Area to the Burned Houses, you will approach from the east. There will be several burned houses with a large one right in the middle. The first drug package is behind the large house.

When standing in the area where you found the first package, look at the lone burned house across the river to the west. Swim over to the house and enter the ruins. The drug package will be right inside the house on the north side.

Return to the large, burned house where you found the first package and make your way west toward the camp. When facing the trailer, you will see a red house to the right, and a small campsite to the left with a small kiddie pool. The third package is located inside the kiddie pool.

The Pelican Valley area is located north of Cottonmouth Lake, northwest of the currently inactive Sunrise RV Park Kingfishers Illegal Operation, as shown in our map screenshot below:

While there will not be any men around to stop you from recovering the drug packages, the Pelican Valley drop is filled with alligators. So be sure to avoid (or shoot) them to stop being attacked.

Pelican Valley Package 1 and Package 2 Locations

When approaching from the south, look north to spot a cluster of alligators around an ice chest. The first and second packages are right next to each other next to the ice chest. Take the alligators out to grab the drug packages.

The Thorpe Adventures area is located northwest of the Pelican Valley area, just north of Gullet Marsh, as shown in our map screenshot below:

When staring west, you will see a compound with a vehicle and house to the left. The first package is on the ground in front of the house. When approaching the package, you will hear a couple of men inside the house talking about how good to cocaine is. Sure enough, when you go to collect the cocaine, you will discover that it has been taken.

Approach the house, break the door down, kill the two men inside, and loot all the half bricks of cocaine on the counter.

With all the drug packages in hand, make your way back to Key Lento to sell them to either Donnie ($3,400) or Brian ($2,720).

We recommend selling them to Donnie, as you will get more money for your efforts , though as pointed out earlier, his stash spot becomes unavailable past the Clear Skies main mission, meaning you'll only be able to sell to Brian if you wait.

Once the drugs are turned in, wait for your money to arrive, but until then, this mission is over.

articles.title: Ring the Bell! Walkthrough - GTA 6 Guide - IGN
articles.summary: When you’re on your way to meet Brian at the Marina after Day Release, Cal can text Jason asking to get drinks. You can tell him you don’t have
articles.body:
When you’re on your way to meet Brian at the Marina after Day Release, Cal can text Jason asking to get drinks. You can tell him you don’t have time, but he’ll text again. Respond to his call for booze to get some special, quality time with Cal and potentially some unique rewards. Visit The Rusty Anchor before meeting Brian to play the Ring the Bell! optional encounter in GTA 6 ’s Chapter 1.

Walk to the back of The Rusty Anchor and you’ll find Cal chatting with another Rusty regular, Rhonda. Talk to Cal and he’ll invite you to grab a shot off the bar. You can drink it, or you can focus on Cal and tell him you’re good and pass on the shot.

If you take the shot, Cal asks Jason to do another shot. The longer it takes you to grab it, the more Cal taunts Jason. Cal offers one more shot, bringing the total to three. If you take all three shots the screen gets blurry on the edges and movement isn’t as precise.

Regardless of your choice, Cal goes into the Rusty. Shortly after he’ll call to Jason, and you’ll need to follow after him as he stops just beyond the doorway. Talk to the very drunk Cal. It seems tonight isn’t the night for him and Rhonda and Cal asks Jason for a ride home.

Give Ride Home – The mission continues and you’ll need to take care of Cal. You can ditch him, but you won’t get the mission reward.

Give It a Minute – Jason declines once, then you get one more chance to give Cal a ride. If you reject him again, Cal stumbles off and the mission ends early and you won’t get the reward from Cal.

If you choose to help Cal, he’ll sway all the way out of the Rusty, rockier than a ship on a storm. Keep focused on him and you’ll spot at least one optional interaction before he remembers he needs to go to the bathroom and does so in the plants. Wait for him to finish, then follow him to his truck not far away. Just a few steps away Cal falls but doesn’t get back up. Here you’ll have a few opportunities to help him, or leave him be. Move over to help him and stay close. He won’t be able to open the car door, giving you the option to assist the poor guy before climbing into the driver’s side, or you can help after getting in the car.

Drive Cal home. If you took the shots with Cal you’ll notice the car veers slightly to one side or another while driving (is it really much worse than your normal driving?). As you drive, Cal shouts out the window. Once you’re arrive at Cal’s house get out of the truck and help him up the stairs.

Your reward for completing this mission comes later after Cal texts you, asking you to pick up his Wet T-shirt contest prize from The Rusty Anchor. The prize items are always available at the Rusty, but you can’t buy them unless you help Cal in this mission.

Rewards: If completed, White Rusty Anchor T-Shirt and Rusty Anchor Cap

articles.title: Netflix's The Altruists Makes the FTX Crypto Scammers Out to Be Unpleasant Yet Highly Watchable Weirdos
articles.summary: The Altruists, created by Oscar-winning Graham Moore, traces the rise and fall of the crypto exchange FTX and the hedge fund Alameda Research by a close-read of the relationship between Sam Bankman-Fried and Caroline Ellison.
articles.body:
This is a spoiler-free review of The Altruists (though can you really spoil real life?). The eight-episode series is now streaming on Netflix.

2022 was a banner year for TV shows based on true stories about tech CEOs behaving badly, fraudsters, and sometimes both: The Dropout, WeCrashed, Inventing Anna, Super Pumped. It was also the same year that the crypto exchange FTX and the crypto hedge fund Alameda Research filed for bankruptcy, revealing that the two companies founded by Sam Bankman-Fried, “the J.P. Morgan of crypto,” and his math whiz business partner/on-off girlfriend Caroline Ellison were not just closely affiliated; Alameda was funding trades with FTX customers’ money to the tune of $8 billion.

2026 is another standout year for similar entertainment: You Can See Everything, The Social Reckoning, Musk, Artificial. Once again, FTX is in the mix, this time via The Altruists, an eight-episode Netflix series that traces the rise and fall of “ Scam Bankman-Fraud ” and Ellison, dubbed the Bonnie and Clyde of crypto. While it’s at times maybe more sentimental than it needed to be in humanizing the two, The Altruists doesn’t hold back on its assessment of Bankman-Fried and Ellison as two unpleasant weirdos who knew how to draw the worst out of each other.

Created by Graham Moore, who won the adapted screenplay Oscar in 2015 for The Imitation Game, and based on reporting by New York Magazine, The Altruists begins with the end. Audio news clips about FTX and Alameda’s bankruptcy scandal play over to Anthony Boyle’s Bankman-Fried seconds from being arrested, screening a call from Ellison (an unrecognizable Julia Garner). Before he decides whether to answer, it cuts back to 2016 as Bankman-Fried practices human reactions in the mirror during his early days as a money-making savant at the quant trading firm Jane Street, where he met Ellison.

The Altruists jumps across timelines throughout, and it’s largely effective. In bopping between the contrasting rosy early days and the tension-wracked lead-up to the FTX collapse, the parallel edits serve as a useful tool in watching just how much of their souls Bankman-Fried and Ellison sold to keep their companies afloat. They were up to some risky, sketchy stuff from the beginning, but it was in the pursuit of following the ethos of effective altruism, a philosophical movement popular in tech spaces that, as The Altruists describes it, boils down to the idea of making as much money as possible to give away to charitable causes. But as the director for the Center of Effective Altruism told New York Magazine in 2022 : “There has not been a bad actor in history who hasn’t been able to couch their conduct behind some meaningful and generally positive ideology.” (The front of that issue featured a portrait of Bankman-Fried along with the coverline “The Virtue Was the Con.”)

Like its approach to explaining EA, The Altruists maintains a fairly narrow scope ostensibly out of necessity; how easy it would be to go down the rabbit hole of explaining every connection, decision, and detail. It mostly ignores the outside media curiosity to focus on the relationship between Bankman-Fried and Ellison. What the series loses as a result is the bigger picture of just how massive FTX was at its height — though it’s always floating in the background, telegraphed through the sheer amount of wealth shown off on yachts and swanky houses in the Bahamas.

Bankman-Fried was hailed as a visionary, the “next Warren Buffet” who would democratize money, as he cruised through meetings while playing League of Legends . He was invited to the Met Gala and built relationships with politicians and celebrities. The Altruists, on the other hand, depicts him less flatteringly: He was a socially awkward dork whose best ideas seem to have come from other people. The show isn’t terribly kind to Ellison either: She was a straight-shooter who was into writing smutty Harry Potter fan fiction, LARPing, and polyamory. Boyle and Garner are both excellent as Bankman-Fried and Ellison, each doing an affected character voice that is perfectly grating. But Garner — who played a different scammer, Anna Delvey, in Netflix’s Inventing Anna — is the highlight, sinking into her role to the point the prosthetics started to seem like natural extensions of her face.

The script’s one major flaw is something that doesn’t really have an alternative, more elegant workaround. Despite the attempt to simplify a complicated story, The Altruists still needs to explain finance and economic concepts to a Netflix audience. It spells these things out by putting two of its (very smart!) characters into conversations where one brings up a concept, i.e. a prisoner’s dilemma, the other person rebukes them saying they “know what it is,” and then the first person continues to explain it anyway. Again, it’s a hard problem to get around if jargon-spouting, a la Industry, isn’t the goal. Even if it’s laid out in broader strokes, The Altruists wants the audience to grasp just who these people are and what they’ve done.

articles.summary: Shirley’s Rum is one of the first Stranger missions you’ll encounter in Grand Theft Auto VI. When returning home during Chapter 1, Jason's
articles.body:
Shirley’s Rum is one of the first Stranger missions you’ll encounter in Grand Theft Auto VI . When returning home during Chapter 1, Jason's neighbor, Shirley, asks him to go and buy her a bottle of Salty Squid rum. This official IGN GTA 6 guide walks you through the Shirley's Rum mission, including important details on an optional mission you definitely should not miss.

After collecting the rent from Mandy for Brian during the Pipework main mission , head back over to Jason’s safehouse. As you approach, you’ll hear Jason’s neighbor, Shirley, calling for him, and the game will prompt you to use Focus Mode ( Left Stick Click + Right Stick Click / Left Stick Click + Right Stick Click ) to investigate the noise. It'll reveal Shirley as the source of the voice. Speak to her and she will ask you to go to the Three Sheets liquor store nearby and get her a bottle of Salty Squid rum. Sounds delicious.

Press L2 / LT to bring up conversation options with Shirley and select "Sure."

Follow the marker to the Three Sheets liquor store, which is right down the street, just east of Donnie's Trailer, as shown in our map screenshot below.

Head inside the store and you'll notice that the clerk will be distracted by some strange noises coming from the back. Hold L2 / LT to talk to the clerk and ask him about the bird noises by selecting the "Are those birds?" option with Cross / A .

Asking the clerk about the noises will unlock the Exotic Animals Front Strange Noises Illegal Operation , where you investigate further into where the weird sounds are coming from. It’s highly recommended that you fully complete Shirley's mission first - or at least make sure to get the Salty Squid rum.

Interacting with the Strange Noises mission will cause a shootout to occur, and because of that, the liquor store will close for a while, barring you from getting Shirley’s Rum if you didn’t pick it up beforehand.

We recommend finishing her mission, then heading back to Three Sheets and checking out the noises to save yourself having to return later on when you're further away.

The clerk will deny that anything is back there and return to the register. Talk to him again and select the "Shirley's rum" option to inquire about Shirley’s drink.

He’ll set it on the counter. Press Triangle / Y to pick up the rum and leave the store.

Set your destination to the SB marker and drive there to return to Shirley. Interact with her to give her the rum.

You'll receive a positive increase to your Criminal Profile as a reward, as getting the rum for her is classed as an Act of Kindness.

articles.title: The Retired LEGO 3-in-1 T. rex Drops to a New Low Price for Amazon's Black Friday Sale
articles.body:
Amazon's Black Friday sale has officially started, which means good LEGO deals are finally starting to arrive. With many sets officially retired, Amazon is dropping prices on some of the coolest builds that are about to disappear forever. One such set is the 3-in-1 T. rex, which has dropped down to to the lowest price I've ever seen, now $41.99 (30% off).

The 3-in-1 T. rex set has been officially retired by LEGO, which means you can't buy it directly from the LEGO website anymore. Many major retailers still have the set in stock, but discounts on retired sets like this one tend to sell out rather quickly.

There are a lot of really cool LEGO dinosaur sets out there, but most of the modern builds are part of the Jurassic World theme. This 3-in-1 T. rex was one of the last remaining sets without an outside IP influence, but it was officially retired a the end of last year.

Like any 3-in-1 set, the coolest thing about it is that you can build mutliple things. The T. rex is the biggest and most impressive use of the bricks included, but you can also build a triceratops or a pterodactyl. Each different version of the set includes movable parts that let you pose your dinosaur in a variety of positions. With an age rating of 9+, it's a fun build for both kids and adults who have the patience for 626 pieces.

As someone who has built a few 3-in-1 sets myself, I'd definitely suggest having an idea of which dinosaur you want to build before diving into it. The default set will be the T. rex as it used all of the pieces, but once you build that it gets harder to change it to one of the other options. I had the chance to build the big 3-in-1 Horse Knight Castle last year and just didn't have the heart to tear it down to try the other two builds.

LEGO's Black Friday Sale Kicks Off Next Week

The official LEGO Black Friday sale doesn't actually start until actual Black Friday, which lands on November 27 this year. The LEGO Store will be hosting its annual Insider's Weekend event starting this Saturday, but that's more about loyalty points than straight discounts.

articles.body:
Amazon is going all out on the early Black Friday LEGO deals this year. On its official Amazon page, you can get the LEGO Star Wars Mandalorian's N-1 Starfighter set (#75325) for $41.99, nearly $20 off of its original $59.99 sticker price. This is a pretty good deal on a great set on its own, but what makes this discount even more special is that the N-1 Starfighter set was officially retired in July this year. It's not entirely uncommon for Amazon to maintain stock of retired LEGO sets, but this popular set may be your last chance to grab one at a lower price before the value increases.

LEGO Star Wars Mandalorian's N-1 Starfighter

The 412-piece build is a faithful recreation of the Mandalorian's repurposed Naboo starfighter we see in the earlier episodes of the Disney+ series. This build specifically is from The Book of Boba Fett , where Din Djarin has it restored after losing his prized Razorcrest. It was some cool interactive elements, like a cockpit that opens and fireable lasers. It also includes four minifigures: the Mandalorian, the mechanic Peli Motto, Grogu, as well as a BD droid. These are also detailed versions of the onscreen counterparts, but the Grogu and BD droid figures are smaller single-brick pieces instead of fully buildable minifigures.

The final build measures in at 16.5in. long, 11.5in. wide, and 2.5in. tall, so you might need some space to display with the rest of your collection, and it makes a great gift for any Star Wars fan to pick up in time for the winter holidays and before it's gone for good.

articles.summary: Skunk Apeology 101 is one of the earliest major side missions you can complete in Grand Theft Auto VI. You can begin and finish it as early as Chapter 1. This
articles.body:
Skunk Apeology 101 is one of the earliest major side missions you can complete in Grand Theft Auto VI . You can begin and finish it as early as Chapter 1. This official IGN GTA 6 guide walks you through exactly how to start Skunk Apeology 101, as well as a full step-by-step walkthrough of every part of the mission, including finding Mr. Mangrove and which ending to choose.

(started by interacting with a Skunk Ape poster - easiest and earliest location is the Rusty Anchor bar in Key Lento)

Click on a link below to jump to that specific section of this guide:

GTA 6 Skunk Apeology 101 Quest Walkthrough and Guide

Over 20 Wanted flyers are spread out across the Leonida Keys for a mysterious Bigfoot-like creature named Skunk Ape. One of the easiest and earliest versions of this poster to find is just inside the Rusty Anchor bar within Key Lento – this is the bar the gang spends time together in Tap to Reveal . You can also find the Skunk Ape flyers in other buildings as well, such as Key Lento Ammu-Nation, Fleeca Bank, the strip club...almost anywhere with a notice board.

When looking at the front of the bar, walk through the front door and immediately turn to your right.

Behind the open door, tucked into the corner, you’ll find one of the Skunk Ape flyers, which you can interact with. Included on the flyer is the phone number for a man named Kirk. Once Jason has interacted with the poster, he will enter the contact info into his phone. Calling the number will send Jason to Kirk’s voicemail, telling you that he is actively looking for Skunk Ape, and to meet him in Pelican Valley near Thorpe Adventures in the evening.

How to Find and Meet Kirk – Exact Location

At around 10:00 PM in-game-time, head to Pelican Bay. On the map, this is north of Pelican Valley, west of Hamlet, and east of Watson Bay. As you approach the area, you will start seeing drones flying overhead.

Follow their lights to spot a man on a laptop controlling the drones in the bed of his truck; this is Kirk. Talk to Kirk and he’ll explain that he is looking for Skunk Ape effigies in the nearby forest area. After scanning you with his EMF scanner, he will give Jason a stick and tell him to whack his truck. It’s also at this point that Kirk will tell you that Skunk Ape’s name is Mr. Mangrove.

Hit the truck with the stick, and you will hear Skunk Ape howling from far away. Kirk will suggest you guys enter the forest to find him. At this point, open your weapon wheel with L1 / LB and select the equipment tab on the bottom right. Cycle through your equipment until you find your flashlight – this will make navigating the forest much easier as you’ll be able to see better.

Follow Kirk as you enter the forest. He will lead Jason to an effigy, and suspects that Skunk Ape is nearby. It is at this moment that he reveals hitting his truck with the stick is how he communicates with Skunk Ape. After inspecting the effigy, Kirk suggests that he and Jason split up to search the immediate surrounding area (marked with a pink circle on your mini-map) to look for Skunk Ape. As you walk around with your flashlight out, follow the grunt sounds that Skunk Ape makes. Use Focus Mode to see the circle ripples and be sure to follow them as you search the area. As you get closer to the noises, Skunk Ape will appear, and Kirk will begin to chase him. Your objective will change to tell you to chase Mr. Mangrove, and a pink circle will appear on your mini-map.

Follow it and you’ll find yourself with Kirk at another effigy. Inspect it to discover that it looks like Kirk and learn that it’s actually Mr. Mangrove hunting Kirk and not the other way around. Because Jason and Kirk stood next to the effigy for too long, breathing in its spores, the pair will start to hallucinate, and a giant boar will approach them. Run toward Kirk’s truck as fast as you can and don’t look back. If you take too long, the boar may hit you, but don’t worry, you’ll still wake up next to the truck.

If you manage to escape, Kirk explains that Mr. Mangrove won’t venture out onto the street and that you should be safe. He’ll then leave, but not before telling you he’ll be in touch.

How to Find Three Effigies - All Locations

After some time has passed, a group text will appear on your phone with Kirk and Lucia. Kirk explains that there are more effigies to be found and that he needs Jason to find them. He will send you an effigy search area, which you can GPS to directly from the message.

The effigy search area is large and covers the area where Jason and Kirk originally found Mr. Mangrove, stretching down south well into Pelican Valley. You won’t be given much clue as to where these effigies are, but the great news is that there are nine in total and you only need to find three. The effigies are split into three designs: Kirk effigies, three Mr. Mangrove effigies, and three wife effigies.

Use the map below to see where all nine of these effigies are. When you are in the area marked on the map above, go into Focus Mode with Left Stick Click + Right Stick Click / Left Stick Click + Right Stick Click and look around – you should quickly spot the effigy as it’ll be flashing white. The three you choose to interact with are up to you as it doesn’t affect the outcome at all. After inspecting each effigy, Jason will inform Kirk via text message. Once you've found the third effigy, Kirk tells Jason that he has all the data he needs and that he will be in touch to finally put an end to this Mr. Mangrove business.

After Kirk contacts Jason, it’s finally time to hunt Mr Mangrove. Head to Kirk’s marker near Cottonmouth Lake and chat with him. He will hand Jason a sniper rifle filled with custom tranquilizers (Mister Mangrove Laird 350 weapon variant) before leading Jason to a helicopter piloted by his partner, Noah. Once you’re in the air, you’ll control Jason, who will be using the sniper rifle to track Mr. Mangrove. As you ride in the helicopter, Kirk will give a brief recap of the story thus far and explain that Jason needs to look where the spotlight is pointing, since he’ll have Mr. Mangrove in the light.

After flying for a while, Kirk will inform Jason that you’re close. Once the spotlight shows, up, aim at it and tap Right Stick Click / Right Stick Click to use the scope. Mr. Mangrove will be sprinting through the tree. Aim at him with the scope and put as many tranqs in him as you can.

When targeting Mr. Mangrove, the aiming reticle will mostly stay on him, so you shouldn’t have too much trouble getting in a few shots. Also, you do not need to lead your shots, meaning you don’t need to shoot where Mr. Mangrove will be as he runs. Shooting him directly will do the trick. After you’ve buried a few shots into Mr. Mangrove, Kirk will tell you that he is heading into some buildings and he wants to land and have Jason go investigate. When approaching the ground, keep an eye on the dock, which is lit by a blue light, and you’ll spot Mr. Mangrove running to the right. Once you land and gain control of Jason, you’ll be right in front of the dock you saw Mr. Mangrove running on, along with an overturned boat. Hop onto the dock and run right toward the stack of barrels under the orange light. To the right of the stack of barrels is a small shack with a door you can go through. Go into it to finally find Mr. Mangrove, who is suffering from the effects of the many tranqs you laced him with. He will then collapse.

Approach him and select the prompt to pick him up. Jason will turn Mr. Mangrove over, who then sprays spores directly into Jason’s face, causing him to black out.

Due to the spores Jason ingested, he begins hallucinating. As he lays down, a frog will jump on his chest, and after a moment, you’ll be in control of the frog. A voice in your head (which is Mr. Mangrove talking to you) will tell you that you need to feed.

Look at the door of the shack and enter Focus Mode to reveal a sound ripple, which is a large cluster of flies just outside the shack. Head toward the sound and once close enough, you’ll get the prompt to eat the flies. Tap R2 / RT a few times until the flies are gone – but you’ll need more. After eating the flies around the boar, you’ll notice that you are in front of an alligator pen. Do NOT enter it, as there is an alligator in there. Instead, go around to the right of the pen . Enter Focus Mode again, which will reveal another sound ripple of flies. Head toward it, past the firepit and picnic table, to find another dead animal under a light on a dock. Eat the flies, and once they’re gone, continue moving forward on the dock. After passing the animal, go to the right side of the dock as the left part is broken. Cross the small bridge on the right side and look at the lights in front of you. The light on the right will be more whitish-blue, while the one on the left is yellow.

Use Focus Mode and you’ll see that you need to head toward the yellow light on the left. Facing the fan boat, you’ll spot the final board surrounded by flies. Eat them to become a fly. After becoming a fly, the camera will change to first-person, and your objective will be to find Kirk. While looking at the fan boat, you’ll notice the spotlight from the helicopter behind it, to the left. Fly toward it and you’ll see the helicopter across the water. Once you approach Kirk and Noah, it will be revealed from their conversation that Mr. Mangrove is actually a man named Harry Sherrick. Kirk also mentions that Harry has a tattoo of a QR code under his fur, which leads to a bank account full of money, and that he has no intention of mentioning the bank account to Jason, as he would rather only split the money with Noah instead of also cutting Jason in.

Which Ending to Choose – All Outcomes and Rewards

After Kirk’s conversation with Noah, he will kill the fly and Jason will wake up in the shack. As he wakes up, Kirk enters the shack and asks Jason to help him get Mr. Mangrove. Armed with the knowledge of Kirk’s betrayal, you have a decision to make.

Point the gun at Kirk and begin interrogating him about Harry Sherrick. After threatening and then questioning him, Kirk will reveal that he knows for a fact that Mr. Mangrove is Harry, and that he will cut Jason in. Mr. Mangrove will attempt to stand up and Kirk will tell Jason to shoot him. Shooting Mr. Mangrove means that you’ve decided to side with Kirk. Kirk will call out to Noah, who will then enter the shack, pick up Mr. Mangrove, and carry him to the helicopter. Kirk will tell Jason that he is sending him money and go to leave the shack. When he does, follow Kirk out and interact with him again to reveal two more dialogue options: “Tattoo?” and “I did the work.”

Pressing Kirk about the tattoo will reveal the information about the QR code leading to Harry’s bank account. Kirk then tells Jason that he will cut him in in exchange for his silence. If you select the “I did all the work” dialogue option, Kirk will get angry and inform Jason about all the work that he has done to get them there – choosing this option doesn’t change the results of the mission.

Kirk will leave the shack and head toward the helicopter. Attempt to follow him, but Kirk will deny Jason entry into the helicopter, telling him that he can find his own way home. As the helicopter flies into the air, it will hover for a bit before commotion begins. You’ll hear Noah and Kirk yell that Mr. Mangrove is awake, and the helicopter will spin out and crash-land right in front of Jason. Go toward the helicopter to discover that Mr. Mangrove is no longer inside, but you’ll find Noah and Kirk burnt to a crisp. At this point, the mission is over.

Point your gun at Kirk and start interrogating him about Harry Sherrick. After threatening and questioning him, Kirk will reveal that Mr. Mangrove is Harry, and that he will cut Jason in to the deal. Mr. Mangrove will attempt to stand up, and Kirk will tell Jason to shoot him. Instead of shooting Mr. Mangrove, shoot Kirk instead . Kirk will collapse onto the ground. Mr. Mangrove will stand up, pick Kirk up and put him over his shoulder, and leave the shack and disappear into the night. Noah will appear and announce that he’s leaving. He’ll get into the helicopter and fly away, and at this point, the mission is over.

No matter which ending you pick, you’ll receive $30,000 and you’ll get to keep the Mister Mangrove Laird 350 weapon variant as a reward for completing the quest.
